author: Shri Raghavendra Swami
commentary: सर्वभूतस्थात्माध्यानविशेषस्य फलमाह ॥  यो मामिति ।  सर्वत्र ब्रह्मादितृणांतेषु स्थितं मां यः पश्यति सर्व च ब्रह्मादिजगत् मयि मदधीनं पश्यति ।  तस्याहं न प्रणश्यामि सर्वदा योगक्षेमवहः स्यामित्यर्थः ।  स च मे न प्रणश्यति सदा मद्भक्तो भवतीत्यर्थः ॥ ६.३०॥
translation:
He who sees Me everywhere and sees everything in Me, to him I am not lost, nor is he lost to Me. I do not disappear from his view, nor does he disappear from Mine. (30.) 
V. In Me: dependent on Me. To him I am not lost: I do not cease to be his protector, i.e., I always remain his protector. Nor is he lost to Me: he does not cease to be My votary, i.e., he always remains My Bhakta. (30)
A. The above is further explained.
